verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a first-party task that runs custom ffmpeg commands (docs-18). That implies audio/video transcoding with codec, bitrate and resolution control, but only through raw ffmpeg arguments. Video files (MP4, MOV) also appear as supported inputs for watermarking (docs-12). The pack has no explicit docs on audio/video format conversion or structured codec, bitrate or resolution options. Missing for 10: documented audio/video format coverage, explicit codec/bitrate/resolution conversion parameters, hands-on or independent corroboration.
